expected: Log no.5 (Error): 'Failed to generate Daily Order Monitoring report.'
execution: Stop the DB connection; export. Then make the file generation fail (test hook).

precondition: Orders of 14-Nov-2026 for DNX and PNJ, some with 5 cycles, SA approved and PO number.

sql_verify.title: Rows expected
sql_verify.sql:
SELECT d.ORDER_NO, d.LICENSE_PLATE, d.STATUS_CODE, d.PO_NUMBER, c.CYCLE_SEQ, c.STATUS_CODE, c.CONTAINER_NO
FROM ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL d JOIN ielp.ORDER_CYCLE c ON c.ORDER_NO = d.ORDER_NO ORDER BY d.ORDER_NO, c.CYCLE_SEQ;
